name: business-growth-kit
description: A general-purpose business growth plugin for proposals, competitor briefs, and marketing campaigns.

interface.shortDescription: Draft proposals, competitor briefs, and campaign plans.
interface.longDescription: A starter Codex plugin for repeatable commercial workflows: sales proposals, competitive analysis, and marketing campaign planning. Designed as a generic MVP that can later be customized with company positioning, brand voice, pricing rules, and internal templates.
defaultPrompt: Use Business Growth Kit to draft a proposal for a B2B software client.
Use Business Growth Kit to create a competitor brief for three alternatives.
Use Business Growth Kit to plan a two-week LinkedIn campaign.
